metadata.source: Bengaluru Municipal Corporation Licensing and Town Planning Dataset
metadata.disclaimer: This is synthetic demonstration data for Indian municipal FAQ chatbot evaluation. It does not represent actual government policy, legal fees, or official BBMP rules.

records.department: Department of Town Planning & Building Inspection, Municipal Corporation
records.description: Required for new structural construction, major additions, or load-bearing alterations to any residential, institutional, or commercial property within municipal limits.
required_documents: Proof of property ownership (registered Sale Deed, Khata Certificate, and latest Property Tax paid receipt)
Architectural drawings and sanction plan signed by a registered municipal architect or engineer
Structural engineering stability certificate from a recognized structural engineer
Site plan showing boundary setbacks, FAR/FSI, and road widths as per Municipal Building Bye-laws
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Fire & Emergency Services (for buildings above 15 meters)
Applicant government-issued identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Passport)
records.fee: Base fee of ₹20,000 (approx. $250 demo rate) plus ₹40 per square meter of gross built-up floor area
records.renewal_procedure: Submit renewal application with licensed structural engineer progress inspection report at least 30 days before expiration. Renewal fee is ₹8,000 ($100).
records.submission_method: Online via Municipal Citizen Portal (e-Plan Approval) or in person at Citizen Service Center, Counter 4.

records.department: Department of Health & Commerce Licensing, Municipal Corporation
records.description: Mandatory municipal license authorizing retail shops, commercial offices, restaurants, eateries, and manufacturing units to operate legally within municipal jurisdiction.
required_documents: Applicant ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Passport)
Commercial premises rental/lease agreement or property tax receipt
Business registration certificate (GST Registration, Partnership Deed, or Certificate of Incorporation)
Fire Department NOC (mandatory for commercial establishments exceeding 50 sq meters)
Food Safety (FSSAI) clearance certificate (mandatory for eateries, cafes, bakeries, and food vendors)
records.fee: Annual fee ranging from ₹12,000 ($150) for small retail shops under 30 sq meters to ₹45,000 ($600) for restaurants, supermarkets, and major commercial enterprises
records.validity_period: 1 year (must be renewed annually before March 31)
records.renewal_procedure: Online renewal through municipal portal submitting last year's license number, self-declaration of unchanged business operations, and payment of annual renewal fee.
records.submission_method: Online via Municipal Citizen Portal or at Citizen Service Center, Counter 6.

records.department: Department of Public Safety and Community Gatherings, Municipal Corporation
records.description: Required for organizing public religious festivals, pandals, outdoor concerts, melas, cultural processions, exhibitions, or sports events exceeding 100 participants.
required_documents: Detailed event proposal specifying expected attendance, dates, and hours of operation
Venue layout, stage dimensions, and emergency evacuation plan
Police clearance and No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from local law enforcement and Traffic Police
Public liability insurance coverage policy certificate
Traffic management and parking layout plan approved by Traffic Police
Waste cleanup and Swachhata sanitation management contract agreement
records.fee: ₹7,500 ($100) per event day for non-profit and community cultural events; ₹25,000 ($350) per event day for commercial ticketed events
records.processing_time: 5 to 7 working days (application must be submitted at least 15 days prior to event)
records.validity_period: Specified duration of the approved event dates only
records.renewal_procedure: Not renewable; separate applications required for each distinct event.
records.submission_method: Submit in person at Municipal Headquarters, Public Safety Desk, 2nd Floor.

records.department: Department of Town Planning & Building Inspection, Municipal Corporation
records.description: Required for non-structural interior alterations, plumbing and electrical re-piping, roof tiling upgrades, compound wall modification, or facade repairs.
required_documents: Latest Property Tax payment receipt for the current financial year
Detailed scope of renovation work from certified contractor or engineer
Residents Welfare Association (RWA) or Apartment Owners Association NOC (if applicable)
Contractor safety and debris disposal undertaking certificate
records.fee: Flat fee of ₹5,000 ($75) for minor interior alterations; ₹10,000 ($150) for extensive plumbing/electrical structural remodeling
records.renewal_procedure: Single 3-month extension permitted upon payment of ₹3,000 ($40) extension fee.
records.submission_method: Online instant e-permit portal or at Citizen Service Center, Counter 4.

records.department: Town Vending Committee (TVC), Department of Commerce & Licensing
records.description: Authorizes mobile food carts, tea kiosks, artisan stalls, and registered street hawkers to operate in designated municipal vending zones under PM SVANidhi framework.
required_documents: Identity proof and residential address proof of vendor (Aadhaar Card or Voter ID)
Passport-size photographs (2)
Food hygiene and safety handler training certificate (for street food vendors only)
Vending cart dimension verification certificate (maximum permitted: 2m x 1.5m)
records.renewal_procedure: Quarterly stamp renewal at Citizen Service Center, Counter 6.
records.submission_method: In person at Citizen Service Center, Counter 6.
